concept.description: Full dependency matrix with Maven generation classification for all projects.
concept.cypher: MATCH (p:Maven:Project)-[:HAS_EFFECTIVE_MODEL]->(em) MATCH (em)-[:DECLARES_DEPENDENCY]->(d)-[:TO_ARTIFACT]->(a) MATCH (em)-[:HAS_SCM]->(scm) WHERE NOT p.version CONTAINS 'stub' AND NOT scm.url CONTAINS 'core-it-support' AND NOT a.version STARTS WITH '${' RETURN CASE WHEN p.fileName CONTAINS '/core-4/' OR p.fileName CONTAINS '/packaging-4/' OR p.fileName CONTAINS '/shared-4/' OR p.fileName =~ '.*/(core/maven|core/maven-4)(/.*|$)' OR p.fileName =~ '.*/(core/resolver|core/mvnd|core/wrapper|core/build-cache)(/.*|$)' THEN 'maven4' WHEN p.fileName CONTAINS '/3.x/' OR p.fileName CONTAINS '/3.9.x' THEN 'maven3-legacy' WHEN p.fileName =~ '.*/plugins/(core|packaging)/.*' OR p.fileName =~ '.*/shared/.*' THEN 'maven3' ELSE 'other' END AS mavenGeneration, p.groupId AS projectGroup, p.artifactId AS projectArtifact, p.version AS projectVersion, scm.url AS projectScm, a.group AS depGroup, a.name AS depArtifact, a.version AS depVersion, a.type AS depType, d.optional AS optional ORDER BY mavenGeneration, projectGroup, projectArtifact, projectVersion, depGroup, depArtifact

concept.description: Version variants per Maven generation — useful for spotting where Maven 3 and Maven 4 diverge on the same dependency.
concept.cypher: MATCH (p:Maven:Project)-[:HAS_EFFECTIVE_MODEL]->(em) MATCH (em)-[:DECLARES_DEPENDENCY]->(d)-[:TO_ARTIFACT]->(a) MATCH (em)-[:HAS_SCM]->(scm) WHERE NOT p.version CONTAINS 'stub' AND NOT scm.url CONTAINS 'core-it-support' AND NOT a.version STARTS WITH '${' WITH CASE WHEN p.fileName CONTAINS '/core-4/' OR p.fileName CONTAINS '/packaging-4/' OR p.fileName CONTAINS '/shared-4/' OR p.fileName =~ '.*/(core/maven|core/maven-4)(/.*|$)' OR p.fileName =~ '.*/(core/resolver|core/mvnd|core/wrapper|core/build-cache)(/.*|$)' THEN 'maven4' WHEN p.fileName CONTAINS '/3.x/' OR p.fileName CONTAINS '/3.9.x' THEN 'maven3-legacy' WHEN p.fileName =~ '.*/plugins/(core|packaging)/.*' OR p.fileName =~ '.*/shared/.*' THEN 'maven3' ELSE 'other' END AS mavenGeneration, a.group AS depGroup, a.name AS depArtifact, a.version AS depVersion, p.groupId + ':' + p.artifactId AS projectGA WITH mavenGeneration, depGroup, depArtifact, collect(DISTINCT depVersion) AS versions, count(DISTINCT projectGA) AS usedByProjects RETURN mavenGeneration, depGroup, depArtifact, versions, size(versions) AS versionCount, usedByProjects ORDER BY mavenGeneration, usedByProjects DESC

concept.description: Dependencies with multiple versions within the same Maven generation.
concept.cypher: MATCH (p:Maven:Project)-[:HAS_EFFECTIVE_MODEL]->(em) MATCH (em)-[:DECLARES_DEPENDENCY]->(d)-[:TO_ARTIFACT]->(a) MATCH (em)-[:HAS_SCM]->(scm) WHERE NOT p.version CONTAINS 'stub' AND NOT scm.url CONTAINS 'core-it-support' AND NOT a.version STARTS WITH '${' WITH CASE WHEN p.fileName CONTAINS '/core-4/' OR p.fileName CONTAINS '/packaging-4/' OR p.fileName CONTAINS '/shared-4/' OR p.fileName =~ '.*/(core/maven|core/maven-4)(/.*|$)' OR p.fileName =~ '.*/(core/resolver|core/mvnd|core/wrapper|core/build-cache)(/.*|$)' THEN 'maven4' WHEN p.fileName CONTAINS '/3.x/' OR p.fileName CONTAINS '/3.9.x' THEN 'maven3-legacy' WHEN p.fileName =~ '.*/plugins/(core|packaging)/.*' OR p.fileName =~ '.*/shared/.*' THEN 'maven3' ELSE 'other' END AS mavenGeneration, a.group AS depGroup, a.name AS depArtifact, a.version AS depVersion, p.groupId + ':' + p.artifactId AS projectGA WITH mavenGeneration, depGroup, depArtifact, collect(DISTINCT depVersion) AS versions, count(DISTINCT projectGA) AS usedByProjects WHERE size(versions) > 1 RETURN mavenGeneration, depGroup, depArtifact, versions, size(versions) AS versionCount, usedByProjects ORDER BY mavenGeneration, versionCount DESC, usedByProjects DESC

concept.description: Dependencies that exist in both Maven 3 and Maven 4 with their respective version sets — useful for migration planning.
concept.cypher: MATCH (p:Maven:Project)-[:HAS_EFFECTIVE_MODEL]->(em) MATCH (em)-[:DECLARES_DEPENDENCY]->(d)-[:TO_ARTIFACT]->(a) MATCH (em)-[:HAS_SCM]->(scm) WHERE NOT p.version CONTAINS 'stub' AND NOT scm.url CONTAINS 'core-it-support' AND NOT a.version STARTS WITH '${' WITH CASE WHEN p.fileName CONTAINS '/core-4/' OR p.fileName CONTAINS '/packaging-4/' OR p.fileName CONTAINS '/shared-4/' OR p.fileName =~ '.*/(core/maven|core/maven-4)(/.*|$)' OR p.fileName =~ '.*/(core/resolver|core/mvnd|core/wrapper|core/build-cache)(/.*|$)' THEN 'maven4' WHEN p.fileName =~ '.*/plugins/(core|packaging)/.*' OR p.fileName =~ '.*/shared/.*' OR p.fileName CONTAINS '/3.x/' THEN 'maven3' ELSE null END AS gen, a.group AS depGroup, a.name AS depArtifact, a.version AS depVersion WHERE gen IS NOT NULL WITH depGroup, depArtifact, gen, collect(DISTINCT depVersion) AS versions WITH depGroup, depArtifact, collect({generation: gen, versions: versions}) AS genVersions WHERE size(genVersions) > 1 RETURN depGroup, depArtifact, [gv IN genVersions WHERE gv.generation = 'maven3' | gv.versions][0] AS maven3Versions, [gv IN genVersions WHERE gv.generation = 'maven4' | gv.versions][0] AS maven4Versions ORDER BY depGroup, depArtifact

concept.description: Project overview with Maven generation classification, SCM info, and dependency count.
concept.cypher: MATCH (p:Maven:Project)-[:HAS_EFFECTIVE_MODEL]->(em) MATCH (em)-[:HAS_SCM]->(scm) WHERE NOT p.version CONTAINS 'stub' AND NOT scm.url CONTAINS 'core-it-support' OPTIONAL MATCH (em)-[:DECLARES_DEPENDENCY]->(d)-[:TO_ARTIFACT]->(a) WHERE NOT a.version STARTS WITH '${' RETURN CASE WHEN p.fileName CONTAINS '/core-4/' OR p.fileName CONTAINS '/packaging-4/' OR p.fileName CONTAINS '/shared-4/' OR p.fileName =~ '.*/(core/maven|core/maven-4)(/.*|$)' OR p.fileName =~ '.*/(core/resolver|core/mvnd|core/wrapper|core/build-cache)(/.*|$)' THEN 'maven4' WHEN p.fileName CONTAINS '/3.x/' OR p.fileName CONTAINS '/3.9.x' THEN 'maven3-legacy' WHEN p.fileName =~ '.*/plugins/(core|packaging)/.*' OR p.fileName =~ '.*/shared/.*' THEN 'maven3' ELSE 'other' END AS mavenGeneration, p.groupId AS projectGroup, p.artifactId AS projectArtifact, p.version AS projectVersion, scm.url AS projectScm, count(DISTINCT a.group + ':' + a.name) AS dependencyCount ORDER BY mavenGeneration, projectGroup, projectArtifact, projectVersion

concept.description: External (non-Apache/Plexus/Sisu) dependencies per Maven generation with version spread and usage count.
concept.cypher: MATCH (p:Maven:Project)-[:HAS_EFFECTIVE_MODEL]->(em) MATCH (em)-[:DECLARES_DEPENDENCY]->(d)-[:TO_ARTIFACT]->(a) MATCH (em)-[:HAS_SCM]->(scm) WHERE NOT p.version CONTAINS 'stub' AND NOT scm.url CONTAINS 'core-it-support' AND NOT a.version STARTS WITH '${' AND NOT a.group STARTS WITH 'org.apache.maven' AND NOT a.group STARTS WITH 'org.codehaus.plexus' AND NOT a.group STARTS WITH 'org.eclipse.sisu' WITH CASE WHEN p.fileName CONTAINS '/core-4/' OR p.fileName CONTAINS '/packaging-4/' OR p.fileName CONTAINS '/shared-4/' OR p.fileName =~ '.*/(core/maven|core/maven-4)(/.*|$)' OR p.fileName =~ '.*/(core/resolver|core/mvnd|core/wrapper|core/build-cache)(/.*|$)' THEN 'maven4' WHEN p.fileName CONTAINS '/3.x/' OR p.fileName CONTAINS '/3.9.x' THEN 'maven3-legacy' WHEN p.fileName =~ '.*/plugins/(core|packaging)/.*' OR p.fileName =~ '.*/shared/.*' THEN 'maven3' ELSE 'other' END AS mavenGeneration, a.group AS depGroup, a.name AS depArtifact, a.version AS depVersion, p.groupId + ':' + p.artifactId AS projectGA RETURN mavenGeneration, depGroup, depArtifact, collect(DISTINCT depVersion) AS versions, count(DISTINCT projectGA) AS usedByProjects ORDER BY mavenGeneration, usedByProjects DESC

concept.description: Comparison of managed vs declared dependency counts per project and Maven generation.
concept.cypher: MATCH (p:Maven:Project)-[:HAS_EFFECTIVE_MODEL]->(em) MATCH (em)-[:HAS_SCM]->(scm) WHERE NOT p.version CONTAINS 'stub' AND NOT scm.url CONTAINS 'core-it-support' WITH CASE WHEN p.fileName CONTAINS '/core-4/' OR p.fileName CONTAINS '/packaging-4/' OR p.fileName CONTAINS '/shared-4/' OR p.fileName =~ '.*/(core/maven|core/maven-4)(/.*|$)' OR p.fileName =~ '.*/(core/resolver|core/mvnd|core/wrapper|core/build-cache)(/.*|$)' THEN 'maven4' WHEN p.fileName CONTAINS '/3.x/' OR p.fileName CONTAINS '/3.9.x' THEN 'maven3-legacy' WHEN p.fileName =~ '.*/plugins/(core|packaging)/.*' OR p.fileName =~ '.*/shared/.*' THEN 'maven3' ELSE 'other' END AS mavenGeneration, em, p, scm OPTIONAL MATCH (em)-[:DECLARES_DEPENDENCY]->(dd)-[:TO_ARTIFACT]->(da) OPTIONAL MATCH (em)-[:MANAGES_DEPENDENCY]->(md)-[:TO_ARTIFACT]->(ma) RETURN mavenGeneration, p.groupId + ':' + p.artifactId AS project, p.version AS version, scm.url AS scm, count(DISTINCT da.group + ':' + da.name) AS declaredDeps, count(DISTINCT ma.group + ':' + ma.name) AS managedDeps ORDER BY mavenGeneration, managedDeps DESC LIMIT 50

concept.description: Reference count per external dependency version, grouped by Maven generation. Excludes Maven-internal dependencies.
concept.cypher: MATCH (p:Maven:Project)-[:HAS_EFFECTIVE_MODEL]->(em) MATCH (em)-[:DECLARES_DEPENDENCY]->(d)-[:TO_ARTIFACT]->(a) MATCH (em)-[:HAS_SCM]->(scm) WHERE NOT p.version CONTAINS 'stub' AND NOT scm.url CONTAINS 'core-it-support' AND NOT a.version STARTS WITH '${' AND NOT a.group STARTS WITH 'org.apache.maven' AND NOT a.group STARTS WITH 'org.codehaus.plexus' AND NOT a.group STARTS WITH 'org.eclipse.sisu' WITH CASE WHEN p.fileName CONTAINS '/core-4/' OR p.fileName CONTAINS '/packaging-4/' OR p.fileName CONTAINS '/shared-4/' OR p.fileName =~ '.*/(core/maven|core/maven-4)(/.*|$)' OR p.fileName =~ '.*/(core/resolver|core/mvnd|core/wrapper|core/build-cache)(/.*|$)' THEN 'maven4' WHEN p.fileName CONTAINS '/3.x/' OR p.fileName CONTAINS '/3.9.x' THEN 'maven3-legacy' WHEN p.fileName =~ '.*/plugins/(core|packaging)/.*' OR p.fileName =~ '.*/shared/.*' THEN 'maven3' ELSE 'other' END AS mavenGeneration, a.group AS depGroup, a.name AS depArtifact, a.version AS depVersion, p.groupId + ':' + p.artifactId AS projectGA RETURN mavenGeneration, depGroup, depArtifact, depVersion, count(DISTINCT projectGA) AS referenceCount ORDER BY mavenGeneration, depGroup, depArtifact, referenceCount DESC
